dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Any updates on the commission from last time? Should be done just about now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Apologies, Mr. Varka. The wine merchants from Mondstadt say they'll need more time to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Also, they have asked me to pass this message on to you: "Have you seriously finished the last batch? That cart was huge!"

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Well, it's not like I'm the only one drinking. That amount of wine is barely enough for two banquets. We'll need more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you trying to empty out Mondstadt's wine cellars...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hah, come on, I timed this down to the second. The Dawn Winery should be re-opening their cellar of Dandelion Wine right around now.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: As the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius in Mondstadt, patronizing their business is but one of my duties.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've left some for them. I didn't clean it all out, or Charles would have nothing to work with.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: The trouble with long journeys, though, is that wine tends to lose its flavor in the process. *sigh* Next time I get back, I'll have Charles mix me the strongest drink he's got.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Now, who to drink with... Kaeya would definitely come if I called, and Diluc... Well, if I can catch him, I'll have a couple of drinks with him too.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hmm... Might as well get those two to have a drink together, perhaps...
